name: Sea Singer
summary: A maritime performer who protects a crew, commands wind and water, and travels with an exotic familiar.

features.name: Sea Shanty
features.summary: Let nearby allies use your Perform check for saves against exhaustion, fatigue, nausea, and sickness, including new saves against ongoing effects.

features.name: Still Water
features.summary: Reduce shipboard movement, sailing, and swimming check DCs within 30 feet by your Bard level, to a minimum DC of 10.

features.name: Whistle the Wind
features.summary: Create a gust of wind for as long as you perform, or for one minute after five continuous rounds.

features.name: Call the Storm
features.summary: Duplicate control water, control weather, control winds, or storm of vengeance after performing one round per spell level.

features.name: World Traveler
features.summary: Add half Bard level to Knowledge (geography, local, and nature) and Linguistics, with one reroll per day plus one every five levels.
features.scaling: half Bard level; rerolls improve at 5th and every 5 levels

features.name: Exotic Familiar
features.summary: Choose a monkey or parrot familiar that advances using your Bard level.

features.name: Sea Legs
features.summary: Gain +4 on saves against air, water, and being knocked prone, and +2 CMD against grapple, overrun, and trip.
